title: Misleading Advertising BEWARE
text: Misleading Advertising BEWARE. These things do NOT keep fizz in as stated. They do NOT form a tight seal at all. If you turn it on its side or upside down your beverage will pour out. Very disappointed and misleading item. Too expensive for what it does.
